name: French

4.name: CEFR B2
4.note: Upper intermediate: news and general topics

learnerProfile: speaks, writes and reads French at about CEFR A2; reads at roughly a young child's level. NOT an absolute beginner. Content must be worth their time and build reading confidence.
styleGuidance: Natural, everyday French. Default to the familiar vous register. Only use tutoiement or formal/administrative register at levels 5-6.

1.grammar: Present tense, basic articles and prepositions, everyday nouns/verbs

2.grammar: Passé composé, common connectors (et, mais, parce que), frequent adverbs

3.grammar: Imparfait vs passé composé, relative pronouns (qui, que, dont), si + présent

4.grammar: Subjunctive after some verbs, indirect speech, reported questions

5.grammar: Abstract topics, formal and journalistic register, connectives of cause and consequence

6.grammar: Idioms, literary register, opinion pieces, nuanced connectors
